question: What per-object cap applies to Utho Archive Storage, and should the archive rate field move from ₹0.38 to ₹0.37 per GB per month?
why: The archive page now states ₹0.37/GB/month and no per-object cap; a search lead names a 100MB object limit on the Utho object-storage FAQ but every read route to that FAQ failed, so the lead was not used as evidence.
